title: National Housing and Homelessness Plan Bill 2024
short_title: National Housing and Homelessness Plan Bill 2024

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would create a legal framework for developing a National Housing and Homelessness Plan focused on human rights.

The Housing Minister must develop the plan with expert advice and assistance from Housing Australia, a National Housing Consumer Council, and an independent National Housing and Homelessness Advocate.
The plan must be fully refreshed every 10 years, with progress reports to Parliament every three years.
changes: Requires the Housing Minister to develop and maintain a National Housing and Homelessness Plan.
Establishes a National Housing Consumer Council to give consumer perspectives on the plan.
Creates an independent National Housing and Homelessness Advocate to monitor progress and review systemic housing issues.
summary.affected: People in Australia who need housing, including those experiencing homelessness, and the agencies involved in housing policy such as Housing Australia and the Housing Minister.
